title: 10Th Intra University Moot Court Competition 2024
clean_text: The Southeast Moot Court Society (SEMCS) organized its landmark 10th Intra University Moot Court Competition 2024 at South University. The event showcased the academic and practical prowess of students from the Department of Law, fostering a dynamic platform for legal learning and competitive spirit. Students from various batches enthusiastically participated, demonstrating their legal acumen and advocacy skills. The presence of alumni who are now well-established in the legal profession as judges lent prestige and authenticity to the tournament. Their expert evaluation provided participants with invaluable insights into the intricacies of legal practice. The grand finale and award-giving ceremony took place in the Multipurpose Hall of South University. The event was graced by the esteemed presence of Barrister Ruhul Quddus Kazal, Senior Advocate at the Supreme Court of Bangladesh and a Member of the Enrolment Committee of the Bangladesh Bar Council, as the Chief Guest. In his address, Barrister Kazal commended SEMCS for its relentless efforts in nurturing future legal professionals and emphasized the significance of moot court competitions in bridging the gap between academic learning and professional practice. It ended with a renewed spirit among students to pursue their legal aspirations with dedication and confidence. In the prize-giving ceremony, Prof. Dr. Yousuf Mahbubul Islam, Honorable Vice Chancellor of Southeast University (SEU), Prof. Dr. Farhana Helal Mehtab, Professor of Law and Dean, School of Arts & Social Sciences, Maj. Gen. Kazi Fakhruddin Ahmed (Retd.), Registrar (SEU), Mr. Md. Jahid Mustofa, Chairman, Department of Law, along with esteemed faculty members of the Department of Law were present.

title: Faculties Of The Economics Department Of Seu Presented A Paper In An Internation
clean_text: Dr. Kazi Tanvir Mahmud, Associate Professor, along with Mohammad Asrarul Hasanat and Fahima Kabir, Lecturers in the Department of Economics at Southeast University, presented a paper titled "Empowering Rural Women: Microcredit's Role in Risk Management in Bangladesh" at the 2nd International Virtual Conference on Education Research and Applied Business Conference (ERABC) 2024. The conference, themed "Global Challenges and Sustainable Development," attracted a diverse range of participants from South Asia and Europe. The paper examined the impact of microcredit on strengthening the risk management capacities of women in Bangladesh.

Biography
Dr. Mohammed Ashikur Rahman is currently serving as an Associate Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Southeast University. Prior to his current role, he served as an Assistant Professor at the University of Liberal Arts Bangladesh (ULAB). His academic career began in 2010 at Atish Dipankar University of Science and Technology (ADUST), where he taught for four years. He then transitioned to the University of South Asia in Dhaka, where he contributed to the academic community for approximately seven years. Dr. Rahman earned his PhD from the International Islamic University Malaysia (IIUM), completing his degree and returning to Bangladesh to further his academic career. He also holds a Master's degree in Computer Networking and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and Engineering, both obtained from institutions abroad. His research interests are centered on Machine Learning, with a particular focus on developing predictive models using simplified neural networks. Additionally, he is involved in research related to the Internet of Things (IoT) and explainable Artificial Intelligence (AI). Dr. Rahman's scholarly work has been published in various esteemed national and international journals, and he actively contributes to the academic community as a reviewer for several Scopus-indexed journals, including the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society and the Journal of Computer Science. His contributions to the field reflect a commitment to advancing knowledge and innovation in computer science and engineering.

Dr. Md. Maruf Hassan

director.ccs@seu.edu.bd, drmdmaruf.hassan@seu.edu.bd

Biography
Dr. Md. Maruf Hassan is an academic and professional with a background in Information Systems, Computer Science & Engineering, Software Engineering and Cybersecurity. He completed his Bachelor of Information Systems from the Australian Catholic University, Sydney, Australia, and pursued his Master's in Computer Science and Engineering at East West University, Dhaka, Bangladesh. Dr. Hassan earned his PhD in Computer Engineering from the University Malaysia Perlis (UniMAP), Malaysia, focusing on advanced cybersecurity methodologies. Complementing his academic credentials, Dr. Hassan has attained several globally recognized certifications, including Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Certified EC-Council Instructor (CEI), and Certified Technologist (CT), further solidifying his expertise in cybersecurity. With over 18 years of experience spanning teaching and professional roles, Dr. Hassan has served at prestigious institutions in Australia and Bangladesh such as Accenture Australia, Australian Taxation Office (ATO), Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Hodavasi Choudhury & Co., Leads Corporation, NCC Bank PLC, Premier Bank PLC, etc. Since December 2024, he has been an Associate Professor in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering at Southeast University (SEU). Previously, Dr. Hassan spent ten and a half years at Daffodil International University (DIU) in the Software Engineering Department, where he contributed extensively as the Director of the Cyber Security Centre, Program Director of M.Sc. in Cyber Security, and Coordinator for Cybersecurity programs at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Dr. Hassan has been instrumental in curriculum development, having designed syllabi for 14 Cybersecurity major courses and the M.Sc. in Cybersecurity program. Additionally, he played a key role in developing the syllabus for Information System Security Management under the RMG & Textile Industry Skills Council (RTISC), a Bangladesh Government initiative. In the academic sphere, Dr. Hassan has published more than 40 research articles in internationally indexed book chapters, journals, and conference proceedings. His mentorship has guided over 40 undergraduate and postgraduate dissertations, with many producing impactful contributions in cybersecurity research. As a committed mentor, he led the Cybersecurity Research Community and the Catch the Flag (CTF) community at DIU, nurturing students' engagement in cybersecurity challenges and research. Dr. Hassan's professional endeavors extend beyond academia. He has conducted numerous technical training sessions, workshops, seminars, and awareness programs on cybersecurity. As a Certified Ethical Hacker instructor, he has trained DIU students to excel in ethical hacking. His ongoing research spans areas such as cybersecurity, web application vulnerability detection, steganography, and authentication. Dr. Hassan's excellence in his field is marked by several awards, including recognition for software products and best paper presentations. His career reflects an unwavering commitment to advancing knowledge, fostering student involvement in research, and addressing critical challenges in cybersecurity.

title: Southeast University Pays Tribute To Language Martyrs On Intl Mother Language Day
clean_text: Southeast University (SEU) solemnly observed the Great Shaheed Day and International Mother Language Day in remembrance of the martyrs of the historic Language Movement of 1952. The university organized a Provat Feri (mourning procession), a discussion session, and a cultural program to pay tribute to the language heroes, administrative officials, and students.

title: Department Of Economics Seu Signs Mou With Dnet For Academic And Research
clean_text: The Department of Economics, SEU signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Dnet, a reputed research organization on 3rd February 2026, to foster joint academic and research initiatives.

title: Young Economists Of Seu Successfully Organized Enact
clean_text: ENACT, the first YES event, brought together students from different institutions to engage in academic competition and policy-oriented discussion. The program featured a Quiz Competition and a Policy Case Tournament, designed to encourage analytical thinking, economic reasoning, and practical policy analysis among participants. ENACT was presented by Synergy Solution and powered by Super Star Group Limited, whose support contributed significantly to the smooth execution of the event.

title: Discussion Meeting And Dua Mahfil Held Honoring Former Prime Minister Begu
clean_text: Southeast University (SEU) organized a discussion meeting and Dua Mahfil at the university's Multipurpose Hall, honoring Begum Khaleda Zia, Chairperson of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) and three-time former Prime Minister of Bangladesh. Officers, administrative staff, and students participated.

title: Southeast University Board Of Trustees Holds 140 Th Meeting
clean_text: The 140th meeting of the Southeast University Board of Trustees was held at the permanent campus in Tejgaon, Dhaka. The meeting was presided over by Mr. Rezaul Karim, Honorable Chairman of the SEU Trust, and attended by distinguished members of the Board of Trustees along with the university management.

title: Ieee Seu Student Branch Celebrates Ieee Day 2025
clean_text: The IEEE SEU Student Branch celebrated IEEE Day 2025, marking the founding of IEEE in 1884 and honoring the spirit of collaboration among engineers worldwide. The event was graced by Prof. Dr. Md. Mofazzal Hossain, Pro Vice Chancellor of Southeast University, as the chief guest. Also present were Dr. Md. Asif Hossain, Branch Counselor; Dr. Md. Shahjalal, Associate Counselor; Dr. Mahjabin Mobarak, WIE Advisor; and Mr. Mahbubul Haq Bhuiyan, Advisor of the SEU Computer Society, along with distinguished faculty members from the EEE department. The celebration featured a cake-cutting ceremony, followed by refreshments and a lively exchange of ideas among students and faculty. The event was successfully organized by the IEEE SEU SB Executive Committee, whose efforts ensured a memorable and inspiring observance of IEEE Day.

title: Two Day Pharma Fest 2025 Inaugurated At Southeast University
clean_text: The two-day Pharma Fest 2025 was inaugurated at Southeast University with the participation of more than 700 students from over 40 universities across the country, serving as a vital platform for pharmacy students in Bangladesh. Distinguished guests at the inauguration included Mr. Muhammad Halimuzzaman, Deputy Managing Director and CEO of Healthcare Pharmaceuticals Ltd.; Mr. Ehsan Aziz, Director of Marketing, Incepta Pharmaceuticals; and Professor Dr. Zakir Ahmed Chowdhury, Chairman, Department of Pharmacy, University of Dhaka. The program was presided over by Professor Dr. Yusuf Mahbubul Islam, Vice-Chancellor of Southeast University. The session was conducted by Dr. Israt Jahan Bulbul, Chairperson and Associate Professor of the Department of Pharmacy at SEU.

title: Mou Signed Between The Department Of Economics Seu And Sanem
clean_text: The Department of Economics, Southeast University (SEU), signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the South Asian Network on Economic Modeling (SANEM) on August 28, 2025, marking the beginning of a collaboration aimed at advancing research, fostering knowledge sharing, and nurturing the next generation of economists.

title: Seus Iqac Hosts Workshop On Baete Accreditation Preparations
clean_text: The Institutional Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) at Southeast University (SEU) hosted a workshop on BAETE accreditation preparations. The program was coordinated by Dr. Md. Masum, PhD, Director of the IQAC.

title: Proud Moment Seu 2025
clean_text: Southeast University shared a proud moment as Mohammad Bayazid Rafi, a student from the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE), attended the 2nd International Terahertz Summer School at the Hangzhou International Innovation Institute of Beihang University in China.

title: The Three Zero Policy Hackathon Business Idea Generation Competition 2025A
clean_text: The Three Zero Policy Hackathon Business Idea Generation Competition 2025, organized by the Southeast Business Innovation Forum (SBIF), brought together student innovators from around the world to explore solutions aligned with Nobel Laureate Professor Muhammad Yunus's Three Zero Mission—Zero Poverty, Zero Unemployment, and Zero Net Carbon Emissions. The program began with a Quran recitation and a moment of silence at Southeast University.

title: Mou With Washington University Of Science And Technology Alexandria Usa
clean_text: Southeast University signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Washington University of Science and Technology (WUST), Alexandria, USA, in a formal ceremony held at the WUST campus in Alexandria, United States. The agreement aims to foster mutual development through joint research initiatives, faculty and student exchange programs, academic innovation, and shared learning resources between the two institutions. The MoU was signed by Prof. Dr. Yusuf Mahbubul Islam, Vice Chancellor of Southeast University, and Mr. Abubokor Hanip, Chairman and Chancellor of WUST. Also present was the President of WUST, Dr. Hasan Karabuk.

title: Southeast Business School Hosts Mba Gala Night
clean_text: Southeast Business School, in collaboration with the MBA Club, hosted MBA Gala Night at the Multipurpose Hall of Southeast University. The event celebrated the accomplishments, perseverance, and professional journeys of MBA students, bringing together academia, industry leaders, and alumni for an evening of inspiration and festivity. The evening was both inspiring and memorable.

title: Irt Of Southeast University Holds A Talk On The Impact Of Climate Change
clean_text: Professor Ainun Nishat, former professor at BUET and former Vice Chancellor of BRAC University, delivered a talk at Southeast University (SEU) on the impact of climate change and the need for sustainable development. The event was inaugurated by the Pro Vice-Chancellor, Prof. Dr. M. Mofazzal Hossain, while the IRT Director, Prof. Dr. Abul Hasanat Alamgir, moderated it.

title: Southeast University And Universiti Malaysia Perlis Sign Strategic Letter Of Intent
clean_text: Southeast University (SEU), Bangladesh, and Universiti Malaysia Perlis (UniMAP) signed a Letter of Intent (LoI) to promote academic and research collaboration between the two institutions. The signing ceremony was attended by SEU Vice Chancellor, Prof. Dr. Yusuf Mahbubul Islam, and UniMAP Vice Chancellor, Prof. Ts. Dr. Zaliman Sauli. Dr. Md. Maruf Hassan, Associate Professor, represented SEU as a delegate at the event.

title: 10Th Intra University Moot Court Competition 2024
clean_text: The Southeast Moot Court Society (SEMCS) organized its landmark 10th Intra University Moot Court Competition 2024 on the 27th and 28th of December at South University. The event showcased the academic and practical prowess of students from the Department of Law, fostering a dynamic platform for legal learning and competitive spirit.
